Subject: SOC2 recert + renewal window — evidence scope & retention ask

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for continuing to support Horizon ahead of our Oct renewal. Two asks from our side as we prepare the recert:

1) SOC2 re-attestation: we need an updated scope document and a firm cadence for delivering evidence artifacts to our audit firm (Kestrel). They expect a staging window in early Sep.

2) Retention uplift: we plan to extend log/audit retention to 24 months (from current 12) for regulatory reasons across EU/US tenants. Please advise on technical feasibility and cost delta.

Attached is our draft scope (Horizon_SOC2_scope.pdf) and a short retention matrix (retention_requirements.xlsx). Procurement copied for contract/term changes (we may move to a 24-month committed term if pricing aligns).

Can you confirm: a) whether Redwood can ingest staged evidence into our secure S3 share, b) projected cost for the retention uplift, and c) whether a term amendment is required to lock a discounted rate for the retention change?

Appreciate a short MAP (mutual action plan) we can share with Kestrel.

Best,
Alicia Gomez

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. We can support the staged evidence flow and a 24-month retention uplift; below is a high-level MAP and immediate asks so we can lock timing and pricing.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Aug 5: Redwood provides evidence ingestion instructions + pre-signed S3 upload location for Kestrel.
- Aug 10-20: Client drops initial artifact bundle; Redwood runs validation and returns manifest.
- Sep 1-7: Kestrel shadow run; Redwood provides extracted logs and control artifacts.
- Sep 15: Formal evidence handoff and SOC2 attestation window begins.

Retention & pricing options (estimates)
- Option A: 24-month archival (standard): +8% on current storage + $0.02/token retrieval surcharge.
- Option B: 24-month committed (12-month prepay): +5% + one-time ingestion assistance credit applied.

Immediate asks from Horizon
- Confirm which option (A or B) you prefer for pricing.
- Provide the Kestrel auditor contact (if different from procurement).
- Share any additional compliance controls that should be included in the scope (e.g., regional log splits).

Attachments: evidence_manifest.xlsx (template we use to validate uploads). I can also open a DocuSign amendment for the committed option once you confirm.

If helpful I can schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the ingestion and MAP.

Thanks Rishi — quick answers:

1) Feasibility: Yes, we can support 24-month retention. We will implement as an archival tier on their existing buckets with region-aware replication for EU/US separation. No regulatory blocker identified.

2) Effort & ETA: 8-12 engineer-hours to enable config + test per tenant. We can complete initial enablement for one tenant (staging) within 3 business days after authorization. Full account (multi-tenant) — 7 business days.

3) Security / Contract redlines: 
- We recommend a one-page amendment that: (a) specifies retention window (24 months), (b) confirms log custody model (Redwood-managed archival with pre-signed export), and (c) sets retrieval SLA (48 hours for standard requests, expedited options available).

Notes:
- Evidence ingestion: recommend they use our secure pre-signed S3 flow. We will validate artifacts against evidence_manifest.xlsx and return a signed manifest.
- Cost: Engineering + storage delta is roughly the Option B estimate (we can honor the prepay credit if procurement moves to a committed 12-month prepay). Exact SKU pricing below; I will have Marcus attach a short cost table.

Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/soc2-evidence-ingest
